targetReport.title: National Medium-Term Development Plan (RPJMN) — statistical targets and monitoring
targetReport.description: The successive RPJMN documents set quantitative targets (poverty, inequality, human development, etc.) that are monitored primarily with BPS statistics. Functions as a high-level recurring-citation policy frame that organises much of the official statistical demand.
targetReport._notes: Central planning-frame node that many social and economic series are designed to serve.
_referenced_by: Poverty, Gini, education, health and welfare statistics
targetReport._url_evidence: Retrieved the Bappenas-hosted official copy of Peraturan Presiden No. 12 Tahun 2025 on the RPJMN 2025-2029. Content verified: defines the RPJMN as the five-year national development planning document for 2025-2029; specifies its four components (narrative, development matrix, ministry/agency matrix, regional development direction); requires Renstra-KL and regional plans to align with it; and mandates mid-term and end-of-period evaluation reported to the President, with indicative targets and funding adjusted annually. rpjmn.bappenas.go.id still does not resolve (DNS), jdih.bappenas.go.id and peraturan.bpk.go.id return 403, and the larger RPJMN narrative/summary PDFs exceed the fetch size limit.
targetReport._url_route: Bappenas e-library static file path (perpustakaan.bappenas.go.id), reached via the Bappenas publication listing rather than the dead rpjmn subdomain
targetReport._cadence_evidence: The cited document is Peraturan Presiden Republik Indonesia Nomor 12 Tahun 2025 tentang Rencana Pembangunan Jangka Menengah Nasional Tahun 2025-2029, dated 10 Feb 2025 - a presidential regulation, not a recurring statistical release.

targetReport.title: Inter-provincial / inter-regional trade statistics (Perdagangan Antar Wilayah)
targetReport.description: Official BPS publication on inter-provincial trade — purchases and sales of goods between provinces, trade maps, and modes of transport. Captures the domestic commercial circulation that links Java, Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Papua and the other islands.
targetReport._notes: Core domestic-commerce node. Shows that Indonesia is not only an international transit state but also a complex internal trading system across thousands of islands.
targetReport._cadence_evidence: 'Perdagangan Antar Wilayah Indonesia 2024' publication page states Periodisasi 'Tahunan' (annual), released 31 Dec 2025, ISSN 2745-6706.

results.bestSpan: Trade data between regions obtained in a complete and continuous manner can support the preparation of the GRDP of Provincial Expenditures.
results.window: The purpose of the Inter-regional Trade Survey is to obtain the value and volume of trade, obtain a trade map, and find out the main modes of transportation used in inter-provincial trade. Trade data between regions obtained in a complete and continuous manner can support the preparation of the GRDP of Provincial Expenditures.
